method: GEOS 3.14.1 `isValid`/`area` over 90 full geometries returned by the adapter; geometries and WGS84 metric cache remain in /tmp.

duplicateObservationAssessment.interpretation: The repeated observations are the same source parcels returned by adjacent viewport bboxes; canonical IDs were deduplicated before pairwise topology checks.

pairwiseTopology.method: GEOS intersects on all 4,005 unordered unique-ID pairs; intersection/area evaluated for all intersecting pairs in EPSG:31983.

nativeIdVerification.gmlFeatureIdBehavior: The GML/GeoServer feature.id changed across viewport/fresh-ID requests for the same native id; do not persist or use it as parcel identity.
nativeIdVerification.persistenceLimit: The numeric native id was stable across this qualification and exact-ID re-fetch; long-term provider permanence semantics are undocumented.

sampleCenter.basis: The 13 approximately 100 m grid cells were centered on the ranked WUP locator; no alternate sample center was used. Exact point probe is empty.
